name: Rance X -Kessen-
source:
Humans and monsters shared the Continent in a delicate balance for over a thousand years, but it all came crashing down.

The most powerful fiend, [url=/c70092]Kayblis[/url], seized power over the Monster Realm and led a colossal army on an invasion of the Human Realm. Unable to stop quarreling amongst themselves, the human nations were trampled.

Two weeks after the war began, the death toll for humanity reached approximately 12,000,000.

Yet mankind still couldn't unite, and the turmoil between the world's leaders continued. Just as the demise of humanity, the worst-case scenario, weighed heavily on everyone's minds...

"Everyone should just work for me. I'll crush that Monster Army no problem."

It was [url=/c735]Rance[/url], back from an adventure with his companion, [url=/c740]Sill Plain[/url].

There was an uproar among the world leaders:

The Kingdom of Leazas's Queen, [url=/c11980]Lia Parapara Leazas[/url].
The Kingdom of Zeth's Viceroy, [url=/c75983]Magic the Gandhi[/url].
The Republic of Helman's President, [url=/c64296]Sheila Helman[/url].
The Free City Alliance's Representative, [url=/c58184]Copandon Dott[/url].
The eastern island of Nippon's Lord, [url=/c2855]Oda Kou[/url].
The world's largest religion, Alicism's Pope, [url=/c738]Crook Mofus[/url].

...And they were also Rance's women, so they all agreed. Rance became humanity's supreme leader and their final hope.

Over 6000 years, a minuscule creature called Kayblis fought and slaughtered his way to the very top of the Monster Realm. A conceited man named Rance, who declares all women to be his, lives a carefree life and finds his way to the top of the Human Realm. Both men put the survival of their entire race on the line in an inescapable struggle to the death.

[From [url=http://mangagamer.org/rance/10/] MangaGamer[/url]]
translation:
人类与魔物在这片大陆上维持了千余年的微妙平衡，如今，这一切却轰然崩塌。

最强魔人[url=/c70092]凯布利斯[/url]夺取了魔物界的统治权，率领庞大的军队入侵人类领地。人类各国却仍在争斗不休，被魔物大军肆意践踏。

战争爆发仅两周，人类的死亡人数就已达到约1200万。

然而，人类依旧无法团结起来，各国领袖之间的纷争仍在持续。就在所有人都为“人类灭亡”这一最坏的结局忧心忡忡时……

“你们全都来给我干活就行了。区区魔物大军，我轻轻松松就能碾碎。”

说出这番话的，是刚与伙伴[url=/c740]希露·普莱恩[/url]结束冒险归来的[url=/c735]兰斯[/url]。

各方领袖一片哗然：

利萨斯王国女王[url=/c11980]莉亚·帕拉帕拉·利萨斯[/url]。
赛斯王国代理国王[url=/c75983]玛吉珂·甘地[/url]。
赫尔曼共和国总统[url=/c64296]希拉·赫尔曼[/url]。
自由都市联盟代表[url=/c58184]科潘冬·多特[/url]。
东方岛国日本的领主[url=/c2855]织田香[/url]。
世界最大宗教AL教的教皇[url=/c738]库鲁库·莫福斯[/url]。

……而她们也都是兰斯的女人，于是全都答应了。兰斯成为人类的最高领袖，以及最后的希望。

六千多年来，名为凯布利斯的渺小生物一路厮杀，登上了魔物界的顶点。名为兰斯的狂妄男人则宣称所有女人都属于自己，过着随心所欲的生活，却也登上了人类世界的顶点。如今，两人将各自整个种族的存亡押上赌桌，展开一场无可逃避的生死决战。

（来源：[url=http://mangagamer.org/rance/10/]MangaGamer[/url]）
